source.method: case detail pages, mid-video frames plus static slide images

instant_comprehension_model.three_seconds: clear relationship between focus and support
instant_comprehension_model.failure_rule: If the page requires reading 4+ equal-weight boxes within 3 seconds, redraw it.

visual_patterns.prompt: Make the slide feel like a premium launch-event final frame: stage/space background, one dominant object or claim, very little text, labels close to the object, no web cards.
Start with a 12-18 Chinese-character claim as the largest visual element. Use industry scene, city, device, map or material texture as atmosphere; keep supporting information secondary.
Use one oversized product/device/model/photo as the main visual. Place only 3-5 short labels near the object. Do not distribute content as equal cards.
Use a photo, map, city, factory, energy field or domain scene as the base layer. Float data labels at meaningful positions, like a strategic evidence map, not a table.
Choose one result or number as the visual hero. Make all other metrics smaller proof points. Avoid four equal metric cards.
Evidence should feel like real material cropped into a PPT: source, use, conclusion. Never draw upload icons, dashed placeholders or ratio suggestions.

cover_keynote.prompt: Design as an industry poster, not a web hero. Full-bleed montage, title as protagonist, far/mid/foreground depth, one sentence positioning, no cards or buttons.

agenda_navigation.prompt: Design as a thematic directory page. Use image band or scene base, large 01-05 chapter numbers, chapter name, page range and one short objective. Avoid timeline navigation.

architecture_system.prompt: Design a hero diagram explaining how the system works. One large architecture/model/path/topology, labels attached to the diagram, clear boundaries and data flow, one bottom conclusion.

practice_evidence.prompt: Use answer-first proof. One huge claim, 2-3 evidence blocks, one result seal or conclusion bar. The viewer must understand the result in 1 second and the proof in 3 seconds.

evidence_chain.prompt: Do not draw a wavy process line. Use a huge claim such as '数据证据 → 生产动作', then three proof blocks: source, processing, result. One result badge only. No equal cards.

value_matrix.prompt: Start with one big value result or number, then use small proof metrics. Scene or material background is preferred. Avoid dashboard metric cards.

hard_bans: equal card grid as main layout
first glance without a clear claim
meta language about scoring or prompts
